podcast.title: First Known Live Rap Diss Performance (1981)
podcast.body: Cool Mo Dee, a member of the pioneering rap troupe Treacherous 3, delivered the first known live rap diss performance in 1981. This occurred at the Harlem World Club, immediately following a performance by Busy B, who had been "taking pot shots at other rappers rhyming skills." "Cool mode D of the pioneering rap troupe Trecherous 3 took the stage and freestyle some music. And dazzling disses against Busy."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Legendary Live Performance Captured on Tape (1981)
podcast.body: Cool Mo Dee's groundbreaking live diss performance against Busy B in 1981 at the Harlem World Club was "fortunately captured on tape," solidifying its place in rap history. This event established the rap diss as a live medium, predating its widespread ignition on wax. "Modi's now legendary live performance was fortunately captured on tape."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Beef with LL Cool J (1987)
podcast.body: In 1987, Cool Mo Dee, known for his earlier live diss against Busy B, "leveled up on the charts by sparking a beef with young upstart rapper LL Cool J." This marked a new phase in his career and the evolution of chart-reaching diss tracks. "In 1987, Cool Mo D, remember him from the historic live disc of Busy B, leveled up on the charts by sparking a beef with young upstart rapper LL Cool J."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
